title: aster bustillosianus
intro: Aster bustillosianus, commonly known as Bustillo's aster, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, potentially aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aster bustillosianus include its ability to reduce inflammation, combat microbial infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may help in protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
